entries.title: Watch and steer a crewmate from its task's card
entries.body: A task's card has a Crewmate tab once a crewmate starts on it. It shows the crewmate's work as it goes: what it says, each step it takes and what came back, the changes it makes to files, the pictures it takes, and its plan, reports, cards and pull request. Type a line at the bottom and press Enter to tell the crewmate something yourself; it reads the line at its next step. Control-C or Stop stops its current turn, and it waits for what you say next. A finished task keeps its Crewmate tab to read back.

picture.alt: A task's Crewmate tab showing the crewmate's steps, an edit's changed lines and the line to type into
